subject.title: fix(memory-core): honor private-network settings for OpenAI-compatible embeddings

question: After the canonical-resolver refactor, should configured memory embeddings inherit provider request policy with omitted exact-hostname trust, explicit false denial, and explicit true broad private-network access?
rationale: The implementation repair is mechanical, but adopting these SSRF trust and fail-closed upgrade semantics requires explicit maintainer security intent.

options.title: Adopt provider policy inheritance
options.body: Use the canonical resolver and accept the documented omitted, false, and true behavior for configured memory embeddings.

options.title: Define a memory-specific contract
options.body: Reject provider inheritance and design a separately approved memory embedding trust policy.

recommendation.title: Adopt provider policy inheritance
recommendation.body: Use the canonical resolver and accept the documented omitted, false, and true behavior for configured memory embeddings.
